verdict.rationale: Clerk documents custom Roles and fine-grained Permissions within Organizations, and gating of individual tool calls by permissions/scopes, but there is no evidence of a true relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy-based (ABAC) authorization model for arbitrary resource-level access control — permissions appear scoped to org membership context rather than granular per-resource relationships. A community report even complains that roles are tied to organizations rather than the user/resource, undercutting the depth of RBAC. Missing for 10: explicit resource-level policy engine, relationship graph modeling, attribute-based conditions, and independent verification that permissions extend beyond org-level roles.
